verdict.summary: The paginated reaction fetch is correctly wired into the live promotion path, uses gh api --paginate --slurp with a larger page size, normalizes the exact shape consumed by should_promote, and aborts fail-closed on a failed API read. The focused self-test is non-vacuous: its only qualifying maintainer approval is on page 2, so removing pagination or slurping makes the asserted promotion fail; it also covers revision binding, normalization, empty output, and API failure. The helper-call-shape split preserves fetch_quarantined's existing argv-list interface while matching the workflow's injected varargs gh function. The PR-time and pre-mutation workflow self-test wiring is coherent, and no hostile embedded instruction was detected in the diff.
